page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; a large oval engraved portrait with curved legend around it; below the portrait a four-line verse caption with signature mark "G 3" and catchword "Floren-" at the right.

main_text.head: FLORENTIVS A. MONTMORENCY. BARO LVSÆ. ET MONTIGNII. GVBEN. TORNACENS.
main_text.p: Me quoque non tristes lachrymæ, gemitusque relictæ Coniugis, aut pietas inuit mea. Perside mortem Consiliis quæ sana dabam, Regisque Tyranni as Patriæ iuxta obsequiis Hispane rependis.

page.notes: The oval portrait is an engraving of a bearded man in armour and a ruff; the curved legend around it is set in capitals and is transcribed in the head above. The caption lines are printed in a larger italic-style roman with some words set in a different type. The line "as Patriæ iuxta obsequiis Hispane rependis" is printed as shown and may contain a printing error. The catchword "Floren-" is printed at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
